case_number: 2024 INSC 82; Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No.2888 of 2023
summary: Conviction under Section 376AB IPC for rape of 7-year-old girl; capital punishment commuted to life imprisonment by High Court; review of sentence quantum; distinction between 'barbaric' vs 'brutal' in offense characterization; offense deemed barbaric due to rape of minor in temple; alternative 20-year minimum sentence under Section 376AB IPC considered; life imprisonment upheld; other POCSO/IPC convictions without separate sentences.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment commutating death penalty to life imprisonment upheld; no further reduction in sentence.
